lessons.title: 1. Simple Decorator
lessons.description: A decorator wraps a function. Implement `shout` that uppercases the string returned by the wrapped function.
learning_objectives: Write a decorator that wraps a return value

lessons.title: 2. Decorator with Arguments
lessons.description: Implement `repeat(n)` that calls the wrapped function n times and returns a list of results.

lessons.title: 3. Memoize Decorator (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Cache function results by args so repeated calls are cheap.
learning_objectives: Cache return values keyed by arguments

tests.name: test_memoize
tests.unittest_code:
def test_memoize(self):
    self.assertEqual(add(2, 3), 5)
    self.assertEqual(add(2, 3), 5)
    self.assertIn((2, 3), add.cache)

lessons.title: 4. Call Counter (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `count_calls` that tracks how many times a function was invoked via `.calls`.
learning_objectives: Attach state to a wrapper function

lessons.title: 5. Unit 18 Checkpoint: Decorators
lessons.description: Implement `ensure_non_negative` that raises ValueError if the first argument is negative.

tests.name: test_ensure
tests.unittest_code:
def test_ensure(self):
    self.assertEqual(double(3), 6)
    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
        double(-1)
